review_candidates.description: The Opportunity Auckland’s construction and property development market is diverse, relationship-driven and commercially significant. To better serve this market and capture its full potential, we have created a new leadership role within our Trade structure. This is not a role where you inherit a finished plan. It is an opportunity to help shape the strategy, strengthen our market presence, build enduring customer and supplier relationships, and lead a team focused on sustainable, profitable growth. Reporting to the General Manager Trade Sales, you will take ownership of the sales performance, supply requirements and growth of Riviera’s trade business within Auckland’s Mandarin-speaking construction market. Working across the Riviera Hardware Holdings Group, you will lead Trade Account Managers, develop customer opportunities, and work closely with operational, inventory and supplier teams to ensure our growth plans can be delivered. You will be expected to understand the market, identify where the opportunities are, and turn those opportunities into measurable sales, margin and customer growth. Professional fluency in Mandarin is essential because you will work directly with Mandarin-speaking customers and commercial decision-makers. Cantonese language skills would be highly regarded. What You’ll Be Responsible For You will lead the commercial development and performance of this key trade portfolio, including: developing and implementing a clear market and sales strategy to grow our presence and market share identifying new business opportunities and building trusted relationships across the construction and property development sector leading and coaching Trade Account Managers, setting clear sales and margin targets and holding the team accountable for delivery developing account plans that grow sales beyond core building products and increase the value of each customer account monitoring sales pipelines, customer activity, market movement and competitor activity working with Trade Operations, branch teams and suppliers to align stock availability and service capability with planned growth maintaining disciplined controls across margin, pricing and customer credit, supported by clear reporting on sales and portfolio performance What You’ll Bring This role requires an experienced commercial sales leader who understands that meaningful growth comes from strong relationships, disciplined execution and consistent follow-through. You will bring: professional fluency in spoken and written Mandarin strong written and verbal communication skills in English the ability to communicate in Cantonese would be an advantage an in-depth understanding of the New Zealand construction and property development market, including established knowledge of Auckland’s construction and building supplies sector a record of growing sales and profitability, supported by strong commercial judgement and confidence working with sales, margin and pipeline data experience leading, coaching and holding salespeople accountable for results a practical and disciplined approach to planning, stock and supply requirements, pricing, credit, risk and commercial controls Why This Role Stands Out This Is a Rare Opportunity To Step Into a Newly Created Position With Genuine Scope To Influence How The Business Approaches And Grows An Important Market. You Will Have ownership of a commercially significant growth portfolio the opportunity to shape the market strategy rather than simply maintain an existing model direct access to experienced senior trade and commercial leaders the backing of one of the largest groups in the Mitre 10 network the scale, product range and operational support needed to turn opportunity into results the chance to build team capability and create a strong platform for future growth career opportunities across the wider Riviera Hardware Holdings Group access to staff purchasing benefits across selected Mitre 10 stores discounts at selected Columbus Coffee cafés access to a range of retail, travel and lifestyle savings About Us Riviera Hardware Holdings Ltd is the largest group within the Mitre 10 network and is proudly Kiwi-owned and operated. Our business includes Mitre 10 MEGA stores in Albany, New Lynn, Silverdale and Warkworth, Mitre 10 Whangaparaoa, a Distribution Centre, a Frame & Truss Manufacturing Plant, and several Columbus Coffee cafés. This diverse portfolio gives us the scale, operational capability and local market presence to support customers across retail, trade, distribution, manufacturing and hospitality sectors. Trade is a core part of our business. Through the strength of the Mitre 10 Trade network, dedicated Trade teams, commercial account solutions and broad product offering, we support everyone from sole-trader builders and trade contractors through to developers and commercial customers across Auckland. This role offers the opportunity to represent a trusted Kiwi brand that continues to invest in supporting New Zealand's building and construction industry. What’s Next If you know this market, are fluent in Mandarin, understand how trusted commercial relationships are built, and have the leadership and discipline to turn opportunity into profitable growth, we want to hear from you. Apply online with your CV and cover letter and tell us how you have made an impact in this market, the customers and sales teams you have helped grow, and how you would strengthen our presence across Auckland’s construction sector.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Title: Service Technician Poland (m/f/d) Id: 20956 Type: FullTime Location: Poland At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Job Description After an initial training period, you will be responsible for the installation, start-up, troubleshooting and preventive maintenance of our injection molding systems at our customers' facilities. You will operate from your home office ideally located in Warsaw, Katowice or Krakow area with general administrative support from our European headquarters in Luxembourg. This position offers great challenges and has a direct impact on the final business result and growth opportunities. It is a unique opportunity to join a very dynamic organization, combining your technology focus and inter-human skills to support our global customer base. Responsibilities Traveling regularly to our customers (area covering Poland 60% of time and Central Europe (40%). Central Europe extends to Greece, you will be responsible for troubleshooting issues, installing or upgrading all Husky products. You will help our customers optimize their operations with on-site training and follow-up visits. You will be responsible for the execution and follow-up of your customer visits, creating reports and offering advice to promote Husky’s products and services. You should be a self-started that understands the importance of customer satisfaction and can be an ambassador for our strong core values. Qualifications Technician or engineering degree - mechatronics or electronics. General experience in control systems, and/or equivalent hydraulic, electrical or mechanical experience. Troubleshooting attitude and focus on correct working practices. Knowledge in PLC controls and in industrial automated systems. Your initiative, your team spirit and time management abilities enable you to deal with multiple priorities in a timely and proactive manner. Some experience in field service and injection molding would be considered an asset. Good English language skills. Fluent in Polish Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

review_candidates.title: Senior Flutter Mobile Engineer (Wearables)
review_candidates.description: Type: Full-time Location: Remote - For people residing in Romania only About HLTH HLTH is one of the fastest growing brands of 2026, reaching the top 3% in growth of all stores in the Shopify ecosystem and we’re just getting started (literally). At HLTH we believe understanding your health should be effortless. Our devices and app turn health monitoring into clear insights anyone can act on. We build for people who care about longevity, balance, and a healthier future because healthcare shouldn't be reactive. It should be proactive, continuous, and deeply personal. Before You Apply  HLTH is an intense environment: we’re demanding and ambitious, which means we ask a lot of ourselves and one another. This means fantastic learning, achievements, and career growth, but it also requires a significant commitment. We move fast, standards are high, and ownership is real. This is not a coast job. If you want to be challenged, stretched, and pushed harder than ever before, we invite you to apply. The Role We are building the future of continuous health optimization at HLTH. Our biometric wearable lives or dies on the reliability of its data pipeline. We aren't looking for a traditional app developer who just hooks up UI views to REST endpoints. We need a Senior Flutter Mobile Engineer who specializes in Flutter to own it end to end: ensuring our app seamlessly wakes up, reconnects, restores state, and processes critical health data over low-power BLE streams without draining the user's device. What You’ll Do Design, develop, and maintain the Flutter and Dart codebase along with the overall xplat architecture Create native bridging modules in Swift and Kotlin for platform-specific features and critical paths. Manage BLE connection lifecycles including discovery, reconnection, state restoration, MTU handling and reliable data transfer without excessive battery drain Integrate the mobile app with Supabase for authentication, database, realtime features and storage, and with Cloudflare R2 for raw and high-volume health data Build offline-first experiences using local storage solutions such as Drift together with secure storage and reliable data synchronization Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Fastlane for automated builds and releases to TestFlight and the Play Console Implement basic error monitoring with Sentry and track key product events through PostHog Establish codebase standards, make architecture decisions, and be an example for junios Work closely with the product owner and designers to turn requirements into polished mobile experiences Who You Are Multiple production Flutter apps shipped to both the App Store and Google Play. Strong Dart and modern Flutter (Riverpod or Bloc preferred). Practical experience writing and debugging native Swift and Kotlin code for bridging and platform constraints. Hands-on production experience with Bluetooth Low Energy Experience owning or heavily contributing to mobile CI/CD Comfortable with asynchronous data streams, offline caching, and REST (or GraphQL) synchronization. Ability to work independently and make sound architectural trade-offs. Requirements 5+ years of commercial Flutter/Dart development experience Proven hands-on experience working with Bluetooth Low Energy in real-world environments Experience supporting BLE functionality across both iOS and Android Practical experience writing and debugging native Swift and Kotlin code for bridging and platform constraints Solid understanding of REST API integration and asynchronous application architecture Experience with secure storage, authentication flows, and modern state management Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, particularly around connectivity issues and device-level edge cases Experience owning or heavily contributing to mobile CI/CD pipelines Nice to Have: Background in IoT, wearables, smart devices, access control, or hardware-integrated apps Knowledge of mobile platform internals related to Bluetooth and background processing Experience with HealthKit / Health Connect. Familiarity with Supabase, Cloudflare R2, Sentry, or similar tools. Protobuf or binary protocol experience. Compensation Pay Range: Based on region and experience Exact compensation will depend on a number of factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, level, years of experience, technical expertise, and other qualifications. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range.  What’s In It For You Competitive Pay  Performance based bonuses Fully remote working flexibility Unlimited PTO (10-day minimum to recharge) Direct access to $9-figure revenue copywriters for coaching Educational learning & coaching stipend Free company devices and app access And most importantly daily scheduled nap time Our Hiring Process Application and portfolio review Screening Interview Interview with the founders Team interview and offer
